<thought>To locate a Wolff‑Kishner reduction template, I will search the template catalog for transformations that break a ketone (functional group name “ketones”) in the forward direction. I will use a simple ketone SMILES (CC(=O)C) as the target molecule and request a few results.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
